author: PacNPal
name: ThrillWiki
short: Look up theme parks, rides and live wait times from ThrillWiki.
description: Search ThrillWiki for parks, rides, shows and companies, check live wait times and today's hours, and see site-wide stats. Uses the public API, so there's nothing to configure.
install_msg: Load it with `[p]load thrillwiki`, then try `[p]tw ride millennium force`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data.
